sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加州的一座葡萄园里发现了一具女尸。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首了，体内血流干涸。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来凶手煞费苦心地隐瞒了她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查到了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“案卷档案”推出的全新系列，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: 1986, young actress Rebecca Schaefer landed her dream job.
sentences.zh: 1986年，年轻女演员丽贝卡·谢弗得到了她梦寐以求的工作。

sentences.en: Beating out thousands of Hollywood hopefuls, Rebecca was offered the second lead in a new Hollywood sitcom,
sentences.zh: 在击败了数千名怀揣好莱坞梦想的人之后，丽贝卡获得了新情景喜剧的第二主角。

sentences.en: which was to air weekly on the CBS television network in a prime-time slot.
sentences.zh: 这部剧将在哥伦比亚广播公司（CBS）电视台的黄金时段每周播出。

sentences.en: To the outside world, Rebecca was a complete unknown, thrust into sudden stardom.
sentences.zh: 在外人眼里，丽贝卡是个彻头彻尾的素人，却突然一炮而红。

sentences.en: But even though she was barely an adult, she had packed a lot into her 18 years of life so far.
sentences.zh: 但尽管她成年不久，在她过去的18年人生中，却已经经历了极其丰富的事情。

sentences.en: Born November 6, 1967, to Father Benson, a psychologist, and Mother Dana, a writer and teacher,
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡·谢弗于1967年11月6日出生，父亲本森是一名心理学家，母亲达娜是一名作家兼教师。

sentences.en: Rebecca Schaefer was a much-loved only child.
sentences.zh: 她是一个备受宠爱的独生女。

sentences.en: She grew up in Eugene, Oregon, enjoying a comfortable childhood.
sentences.zh: 她在俄勒冈州尤金市长大，度过了一个舒适的童年。

sentences.en: Her formative years were filled with horses, poetry, books, the outdoors, and the unconditional love of her parents.
sentences.zh: 她的成长岁月充满了马匹、诗歌、书籍、户外活动，以及父母无条件爱意。

sentences.en: When Rebecca was aged 13, her family moved 100 miles north to Laurelhurst, an affluent suburb of vintage homes and winding tree-lined streets in Portland, Oregon.
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡13岁时，全家向北搬迁了100英里，来到了俄勒冈州波特兰市的劳雷尔赫斯特，这是一个拥有古董住宅和蜿蜒林荫道的富裕郊区。

sentences.en: There, Rebecca enrolled in the elite Lincoln High School, the same school Simpsons creator Matt Groening had attended a decade earlier.
sentences.zh: 在那里，丽贝卡进入了名校林肯高中，这也是《辛普森一家》创作者马特·格勒宁十年前就读的学校。

sentences.en: She excelled at school, where she joined the talented and gifted program, and was elected a student officer.
sentences.zh: 她在学校表现优异，加入了才华与天才项目，并当选为学生干部。

sentences.en: By age 14, Rebecca was often complimented for her wholesome, girl-next-door natural beauty.
sentences.zh: 到14岁时，丽贝卡邻家女孩般的健康自然美貌经常受到称赞。

sentences.en: She strove to do well at school, and was deeply committed to her Jewish faith.
sentences.zh: 她努力在学校取得好成绩，并且坚定地信仰犹太教。

sentences.en: Rebecca considered pursuing a career as a rabbi when she was older.
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡曾考虑长大后成为一名拉比。

sentences.en: She also contemplated careers as either a doctor or a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 她也考虑过成为一名医生或律师。

sentences.en: But it was a chance conversation with her hometown hairdresser, who tended to her thick mop of dark curls, that landed her first break.
sentences.zh: 但正是与家乡理发师的一次偶然交谈，对方打理着她那一头浓密的深色卷发，让她迎来了第一个突破。

sentences.en: Seeing the potential in Rebecca's perfect features, the hairdresser facilitated a meeting with another of his clients, local talent agent Nanette Troutman.
sentences.zh: 理发师看到了丽贝卡完美五官的潜力，促成了她与自己的另一位客户、当地才艺经纪人南妮特·特劳特man的会面。

sentences.en: Nanette wasted no time in signing Rebecca on as a client of the Troutman agency.
sentences.zh: 南妮特毫不犹豫地签下了丽贝卡，让她成为了特劳特man经纪公司的签约客户。

sentences.en: And soon, Rebecca Schaefer's sweet smile radiated from department store catalogues and TV commercials, convincing parents to spend up big on back-to-school iteMs.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，丽贝卡·谢弗甜美的笑容便出现在了百货公司的目录和电视广告上，说服父母在开学季物品上大笔花钱。

sentences.en: Although she had taken part in an occasional school play,
sentences.zh: 尽管她偶尔参演过学校的话剧，

sentences.en: Rebecca hadn't given any consideration to a career in acting.
sentences.zh: 但丽贝卡从未考虑过将表演作为职业。

sentences.en: But her agent found her some extra work on some local TV shows.
sentences.zh: 不过她的经纪人为她争取到了一些当地电视节目的群众演员工作。

sentences.en: Suddenly, a whole new world was opening up to her, and the idea of becoming a doctor, lawyer, or rabbi was losing its allure
sentences.zh: 突然之间，一个全新的世界向她敞开，而成为医生、律师或拉比的想法也失去了吸引力，

sentences.en: when compared to the glamorous world of modelling and performing.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，闪耀的模特和表演世界更具魅力。

sentences.en: In 1984, 16-year-old Rebecca landed a summer internship at Elite Model Management, which meant travelling to the other side of the country to spend three months in New York City.
sentences.zh: 1984年，16岁的丽贝卡在精英模特管理公司获得了一份暑期实习机会，这意味着她要远赴国家另一端，在纽约市度过三个月。

sentences.en: She welcomed all the challenges the Big Apple threw at her and soon felt at home.
sentences.zh: 她迎接了“大苹果”抛给她的所有挑战，并很快找到了家的感觉。

sentences.en: So at home, in fact, that she decided she wanted to stay to see if she could make it there as a model.
sentences.zh: 事实上，她感觉如此自在，以至于决定留下来，看看自己能否在那里作为模特闯出一片天。

sentences.en: Rebecca's parents weren't convinced of the idea, despite Rebecca promising she would see out her final year of high school at an academy for aspiring actors while she was working.
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡的父母对这个想法并不买账，尽管丽贝卡承诺边工作边在一所面向有志演员的学院完成高中最后一年学业。

sentences.en: She made impassioned pleas and wore them down with sound arguments, supported by the agency, which wanted the fresh young Rebecca on their books.
sentences.zh: 她进行了充满激情的恳求，用合理的论据动摇了他们，再加上希望将这位清纯年轻的丽贝卡招入旗下的经纪公司的支持，

sentences.en: Dana and Benson had to admit their daughter had inherited their own adventurous spirits
sentences.zh: 达娜和本森不得不承认，女儿继承了他们骨子里的冒险精神，

sentences.en: and the risk-taking attitude that had seen her father put his career on hold some years earlier to study Yiddish theatre in New York.
sentences.zh: 以及那种敢于冒险的态度，当年她的父亲正是由于这种态度而搁置了事业，前往纽约学习意第绪语戏剧。

sentences.en: Not wanting to stand in the way of her dreams, the Schaafers relented and gave their daughter their blessing.
sentences.zh: 谢弗夫妇不想阻碍她的梦想，最终妥协并给予了女儿祝福。

sentences.en: Rebecca wasted no time, and by August 1984, she was sharing a two-bedroom apartment in Manhattan with five other aspiring models.
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡没有浪费时间，到1984年8月，她已经和另外五位有志模特一起合租了曼哈顿的一套两居室公寓。

sentences.en: She called her parents regularly to let them know how she was doing.
sentences.zh: 她经常给父母打电话，让他们知道自己的近况。

sentences.en: One day, not long after she had turned 17 years old,
sentences.zh: 一天，在她刚满17岁不久后，

sentences.en: Rebecca was in the subway heading to an audition.
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡正坐在去试镜的地铁上。

sentences.en: As she sat on a bench on the platform, she noticed a man pacing back and forth slapping a sharpened screwdriver against his hand.
sentences.zh: 当她坐在站台的长椅上时，她注意到一个男人来回踱步，手里拿着一把削尖的螺丝刀拍打着手掌。

sentences.en: Rebecca was wary, but she noticed another young woman in front of the man who was clearly terrified.
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡保持着警惕，但她注意到那个男人前面还有一个年轻女孩，显然吓坏了。

sentences.en: She marched over to the young woman, a total stranger, and said,
sentences.zh: 她径直走到那个完全不认识的年轻女孩面前，说道：

sentences.en: Hi, it's nice to see you.
sentences.zh: 嗨，很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: Come on, let's go get a coffee.
sentences.zh: 来吧，我们去喝杯咖啡。

sentences.en: Rebecca took the woman by the hand and pulled her up the stairs away from the troubled man.
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡拉起那个女人的手，把她拉上楼梯，远离了那个行为诡异的男人。

sentences.en: Upon hearing this story,
sentences.zh: 听到这个故事后，

sentences.en: Rebecca's mother, Dana, felt proud of her daughter's bravery and quick thinking.
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡的母亲达娜为女儿的勇敢和机智感到骄傲。

sentences.en: She felt that it boded well for survival in this crazy world.
sentences.zh: 她觉得这预示着女儿能在这样一个疯狂的世界里好好生存下去。

sentences.en: In New York,
sentences.zh: 在纽约，

sentences.en: competition in the modelling industry was fierce.
sentences.zh: 模特行业的竞争异常激烈。

sentences.en: Rebecca Schafer was one among an oversupply of young women struggling to find jobs.
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡·谢弗只是众多苦苦寻找工作的年轻女性中的一员。

sentences.en: At five foot seven inches, she was at least two inches below the minimum height to model high fashion, as clothes hung so much better on the girls who were taller.
sentences.zh: 她身高五英尺七英寸，比高空时装模特的最低身高要求至少矮了两英寸，因为个子高的女孩穿衣服效果更好。

sentences.en: She also began obsessing over her perfectly normal weight, comparing herself to the girls that graced the pages of the fashion magazines.
sentences.zh: 她还开始对自已完全正常的体重产生执念，将自己与时尚杂志封面上的女孩进行比较。

sentences.en: At any time,
sentences.zh: 随时随地，

sentences.en: Rebecca could have cut her losses, packed her bags, and returned to the loving embrace of her parents.
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡本可以及时止损，收拾行李，回到父母充满爱的怀抱。

sentences.en: But Rebecca's youthful optimism saw her determined to make the most of the opportunities she had.
sentences.zh: 但丽贝卡年轻的乐观精神让她决心充分利用眼前的机会。

sentences.en: She took up acting class, five hours a day, three days a week, in a class of 20 students,
sentences.zh: 她开始上表演课，每天五小时，每周三天，在一个20人的班级里学习，

sentences.en: and found a theatrical agent willing to take on a fresh young face with a strong work ethic.
sentences.zh: 并找到了一位愿意签下一位工作作风严谨、充满朝气的年轻面孔的戏剧经纪人。

sentences.en: Aiming for work in film or theatrical productions, perhaps eventually getting to Broadway,
sentences.zh: 她的目标是从事电影或戏剧作品工作，也许最终能登上百老汇的舞台，

sentences.en: Rebecca auditioned for a small part in sci-fi movie The Manhattan Project, but didn't get the role.
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡为科幻电影《曼哈顿计划》中的一个小角色进行了试镜，但没有被选中。

sentences.en: Instead, she landed a small but ongoing role as Annie Barnes on the long-running ABC daytime soap opera,
sentences.zh: 相反，她在长盛不衰的美国广播公司（ABC）日间肥皂剧中获得了一个戏份不多但持续的角色，

sentences.en: One Life to Live.
sentences.zh: 剧名为《生生世世》。

sentences.en: Rebecca was grateful for the work, but never took daytime soap seriously as a career choice, seeing the six-month role as a way to earn money, while looking for modelling jobs.
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡对这份工作心存感激，但从未将日间肥皂剧视为严肃的职业选择，她把这个为期六个月的角色看作是寻找模特工作的同时赚取收入的途径。

sentences.en: She wanted to join the ranks of the bright young models on Teen Magazine,
sentences.zh: 她想加入《青少年杂志》上那些光芒四射的年轻模特行列，

sentences.en: Madonna on the cover of Tiger Beat, or, when she was really dreaming,
sentences.zh: 或者成为《虎粉》封面上的麦当娜，或者，当她真正做白日梦时，

sentences.en: Brooke Shields on the cover of Seventeen.
sentences.zh: 渴望成为《十七岁》封面上的布鲁克·谢尔兹。

sentences.en: When her agency suggested that there might be a stronger market for someone of her height in Tokyo, where her pale skin and brown curls would be considered exotic, once again,
sentences.zh: 当她的经纪人暗示，对于她这个身高的人来说，在东京可能会有更大的市场，在那里她苍白的皮肤和棕色的卷发会被视为充满异国情调时，这位野心勃勃的青少年再次毫不犹豫地行动了。

sentences.en: the ambitious teen didn't hesitate.
sentences.zh: 这位雄心勃勃的少年没有丝毫犹豫。

sentences.en: Her parents couldn't believe that their only daughter was travelling even further away to foreign lands, but Rebecca reassured them that she would be alright.
sentences.zh: 她的父母简直不敢相信他们唯一的女儿要远赴异国他乡，但丽贝卡安慰他们自己会好好的。

sentences.en: Rebecca told them,
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡告诉他们：

sentences.en: No matter where we are in the world, we are like a three-legged stool.
sentences.zh: 无论我们在世界的哪个角落，我们都像一张三条腿的凳子。

sentences.en: The saying became her family's mantra.
sentences.zh: 这句话成了她家的座右铭。

sentences.en: Rebecca made the move to Japan in 1985,
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡于1985年移居日本，

sentences.en: within a year she returned to the United States, and once back in New York, her agent gave her the tough truth that she was unlikely to make it big as a model in America.
sentences.zh: 不到一年她便返回了美国，一回到纽约，她的经纪人就残酷地告诉她，她在美利坚作为模特很难大红大紫。

sentences.en: However, she had earned herself a good reputation as reliable and hard-working on one life to live, so her agent advised Rebecca to pursue acting instead.
sentences.zh: 然而，她在《生生世世》中因可靠和努力赢得了良好的声誉，因此她的经纪人建议丽贝卡转而追求演艺事业。

sentences.en: Rebecca began the gruelling job of auditioning and facing rejection after rejection,
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡开始了残酷的试镜工作，面对着一次又一次的拒绝，

sentences.en: as she entered a world that was arguably even more competitive and difficult to crack than modelling.
sentences.zh: 她进入了一个可以说比模特行业竞争更激烈、更难混出头的世界。

sentences.en: She never let the rejections get her down, believing that it was a numbers game, and she would eventually pick up some work.
sentences.zh: 她从不让拒绝击垮自己，坚信这是一场概率游戏，自己总会接到工作的。

sentences.en: Her optimism was rewarded when a casting director remembered her from the audition for the Manhattan Project,
sentences.zh: 当一位选角导演在《曼哈顿计划》的试镜中记住了她，并对她印象深刻，进而邀请她为伍迪·艾伦的新电影试镜时，她的乐观得到了回报。

sentences.en: and was impressed enough to ask her to audition for Woody Allen's new film,
sentences.zh: 并对她印象深刻，邀请她去试镜伍迪·艾伦的新电影，

sentences.en: Radio Days.
sentences.zh: 《广播时代》。

sentences.en: Rebecca got the part, which was too minor for her character to be given a name, other than simply,
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡得到了这个角色，戏份太少以至于她的角色没有名字，只有一个简单的称呼：

sentences.en: Communist's Daughter.
sentences.zh: 共产主义者的女儿。

sentences.en: Work on the sharp, satirical film was fun and rewarding, and soon after,
sentences.zh: 参与这部尖锐讽刺的电影既有趣又充实，不久之后，

sentences.en: Rebecca landed another small part on the Steven Spielberg Twilight Zone-esque television series,
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡又在史蒂芬·斯皮尔伯格的《阴阳魔界》风格电视剧中得到了另一个小角色，

sentences.en: Amazing Stories.
sentences.zh: 《惊异传奇》。

sentences.en: Her role was as a magazine model come to life, in the episode,
sentences.zh: 她的角色是一个活过来的杂志模特，在名为

sentences.en: Miscalculation.
sentences.zh: 《算错账》的那一集里。

sentences.en: Despite these minor successes,
sentences.zh: 尽管取得了这些微小的成功，

sentences.en: Rebecca missed out on the vast majority of the parts she auditioned for, and her modelling work was sporadic at beSt.
sentences.zh: 但丽贝卡试镜的大部分角色都落选了，她的模特工作也时断时续。

sentences.en: She tried to remain upbeat and hopeful, but the bills were mounting, and her phone was cut off.
sentences.zh: 她试图保持乐观和希望，但账单堆积如山，电话也被停机了。

sentences.en: She was just starting to contemplate waitressing, when in the winter of 1986, she came home to a note stuck on her door.
sentences.zh: 她正开始考虑去当女服务员，就在1986年冬天，她回家时发现门上贴着一张便条。

sentences.en: It was from her agent, asking her to urgently get in touch about testing for a new Warner Bros.
sentences.zh: 那是她的经纪人留下的，让她紧急联系试镜华纳兄弟公司的一部新作品。

sentences.en: television series called
sentences.zh: 一部名为

sentences.en: My Sister Sam.
sentences.zh: 《我的妹妹萨姆》的电视剧。

sentences.en: The series was the best starring vehicle for Pam Dorber, an actress who earned Hollywood stardom thanks to her long-running role as Mindy, to Robin Williams' Mork,
sentences.zh: 这部剧是帕姆·道伯的最佳主演剧目，这位女演员因在邪典剧集《默克与明迪》中长期饰演罗宾·威廉姆斯的默克的搭档明迪而一举成名。

sentences.en: in the cult series Mork and Mindy.
sentences.zh: 在《默克与明迪》中出演明迪而赢得了好莱坞明星地位。

sentences.en: In My Sister Sam,
sentences.zh: 在《我的妹妹萨姆》中，

sentences.en: Pam Dorber would be playing the title role of Sam, and the studio was on the hunt for someone to be given second billing to the more established actress,
sentences.zh: 帕姆·道伯将饰演女主角萨姆，而剧组正在寻找一位能在这位资深女演员之后获得第二署名人选，

sentences.en: playing Sam's zany little sister,
sentences.zh: 饰演萨姆古怪的小妹妹，

sentences.en: Patty.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂。

sentences.en: The television producers had seen some of Rebecca Schaefer's auditions, and thought she would fit the bill as Patty perfectly.
sentences.zh: 电视制片人看过丽贝卡·谢弗的一些试镜录像，认为她非常适合扮演帕蒂这个角色。

sentences.en: Rebecca jumped on a plane, and was tested for the part the next day.
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡立刻登上了飞机，并在第二天参加了角色试镜。

sentences.en: Rebecca certainly looked the part of the flighty teen character.
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡的外表确实符合那个反叛少年的角色设定。

sentences.en: She easily passed for a 16-year-old, even though it was nearly three years younger than her actual age.
sentences.zh: 她轻而易举地通过了16岁少年的外形审核，尽管这比她实际年龄小了将近三岁。

sentences.en: The studio executives loved her and the chemistry she had with Pam Dorber, and so it came to be that serious, hard-working, and ambitious Rebecca was cast to play flaky,

sentences.en: Air Force serviceman, just like him, and felt lost in the world, also just like him.
sentences.zh: 空军军人的儿子，就像他一样，而且在这个世界上感到迷茫，也像他一样。

sentences.en: Robert found himself relating to a guy he had previously despised for killing one of his music heroes.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特发现自己竟然能对一个他以前因为杀害自己音乐英雄而鄙视的家伙产生共鸣。

sentences.en: Mark Chapman had been obsessed with the book
sentences.zh: 马克·查普曼曾痴迷于J.D.

sentences.en: Catcher in the Rye by J.D.
sentences.zh: 塞林格的小说《

sentences.en: Salinger and had repeatedly said afterwards that the book inspired him to carry out the assassination.
sentences.zh: 麦田里的守望者》，并在事后多次表示，这本书启发他去执行了这起暗杀。

sentences.en: Robert bought a copy of the book for himself, trying to determine how it had motivated Chapman to kill Lennon.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特自己买了一本，试图弄清楚这本书是如何激励查普曼去谋杀列农的。

sentences.en: He read it twice, but still couldn't figure it out.
sentences.zh: 他读了两遍，但还是没想明白。

sentences.en: Back home, Robert Bardo's erratic behavior led to some brushes with the law.
sentences.zh: 回到家后，罗伯特·巴尔多的古怪行为导致他几度触犯法律。

sentences.en: Over the next year, he was arrested three times on domestic violence and disorderly conduct charges.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的一年里，他因家庭暴力和扰乱治安罪被逮捕了三次。

sentences.en: In one of the incidents, his brother called
sentences.zh: 在其中一次事件中，他的兄弟拨打了

sentences.en: 911 after he and Robert had a dispute over the living room TV, which escalated into violence.
sentences.zh: 911，此前他和罗伯特为客厅的电视发生争执，并升级为暴力冲突。

sentences.en: Both were arrested, and his brother maintained that Robert had gone crazy.
sentences.zh: 两人都被捕了，而他的兄弟坚称罗伯特已经疯了。

sentences.en: Robert was never formally convicted for any charges, but after pleading no contest after the third arrest, Robert was sentenced to an unsupervised counseling program.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特从未因任何指控被正式定罪，但在第三次被捕后作出了不抗辩答辩，罗伯特被判处参加无人监督的咨询项目。

sentences.en: But he never enrolled, and nobody ever followed up on it.
sentences.zh: 但他从未报名，也从来没有人跟进此事。

sentences.en: Rebecca Schaefer had captivated millions playing the irrepressible Patty in My Sister
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡·谢弗在《我姐姐

sentences.en: Sam, and unlike the rest of the cast, she was still very young.
sentences.zh: 萨姆》中将活泼的帕蒂刻画得入木三分，迷倒了千百万人，而且与其他演员不同，她当时还非常年轻。

sentences.en: Whilst the cancellation of her TV show was disappointing, it had certainly not put an end to her career.
sentences.zh: 虽然她的电视剧被砍令人失望，但这当然没有终结她的职业生涯。

sentences.en: Rebecca recommenced the rounds of auditions for film, television, and theatre.
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡重新开始四处参加电影、电视和戏剧的试镜。

sentences.en: She told friends that she still harbored dreams of being in a Shakespearean play, or making the leap from TV star to serious film actress.
sentences.zh: 她告诉朋友们，她依然怀揣着出演莎士比亚戏剧的梦想，或者实现从电视明星到严肃电影演员的跨越。

sentences.en: As always, auditions more often than not ended in disappointment, but at least Rebecca's name was on the radar with casting agents.
sentences.zh: 和往常一样，试镜往往以失望告终，但至少丽贝卡的名字进入了选角导演的视线。

sentences.en: The roles she auditioned for were in big films from top Hollywood producers.
sentences.zh: 她试镜的角色都是好莱坞顶级制片人的大制作电影。

sentences.en: However, she was never quite right for the part, or someone else was just that bit more suited to it.
sentences.zh: 然而，她要么不太适合这个角色，要么就是别人更适合一点。

sentences.en: Rebecca was briefly considered for the lead role of
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡曾被短暂考虑作为浪漫喜剧《风月俏佳人》中女主角

sentences.en: Vivian Ward in romantic comedy Pretty Woman, but was deemed too girlish, with too much youthful sweetness to be taken seriously for the character.
sentences.zh: 薇薇安·沃德的人选，但被认为过于稚嫩，带有太多年轻人的甜美，无法让人认真看待这个角色。

sentences.en: Julia Roberts, who eventually landed the role, was only nine days older than Rebecca, but came across as more worldly.
sentences.zh: 最终得到这个角色的茱莉亚·罗伯茨只比丽贝卡大九天，但显得更加成熟老练。

sentences.en: Rebecca knew that one of the biggest risks for an actor who appeared every week on a popular
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡深知，对于一个每周都出现在热门

sentences.en: TV show was that people could not see that actor as anyone but the character they played.
sentences.zh: 电视剧中的演员来说，最大的风险之一就是人们无法将该演员视为她所饰演的角色之外的任何人。

sentences.en: In an attempt to shed the Paddy association and avoid being typecast, she began to make subtle changes to her appearance that made her look more sophisticated.
sentences.zh: 为了摆脱帕蒂的标签并避免被类型化，她开始对自己的外表做出微妙的改变，让自己看起来更加成熟优雅。

sentences.en: She picked up roles in a couple of made-for-TV movies, sci-fi thriller Out of Time, and a drama
sentences.zh: 她接拍了几部电视电影，包括科幻惊悚片《超越时空》和剧情片

sentences.en: Voyage of Terror, The Achille Laurel Affair.
sentences.zh: 《恐怖航行：阿基里斯·劳尔事件》。

sentences.en: She was able to satisfy some of her wanderlust with
sentences.zh: 她通过

sentences.en: Voyage of Terror, in which she worked with Hollywood legend Burt Lancaster and Eva Marie Saint, and got to travel to Egypt for the filming.
sentences.zh: 《恐怖航行》满足了自己对旅行的一些渴望，在片中她与好莱坞传奇人物伯特·兰卡斯特和埃娃·玛丽·圣合作，并前往埃及进行拍摄。

sentences.en: Rebecca's break into a major motion movie picture came when she was cast to play Xandra, a spoiled daughter in
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡进军主流电影界的机会来了，她被选中在

sentences.en: Paul Bartell's satire, Scenes from the Class Struggle in
sentences.zh: 保罗·巴特尔的讽刺作品《比佛利山庄

sentences.en: Beverly Hills.
sentences.zh: 阶级斗争》中饰演被宠坏的女儿珊德拉。

sentences.en: The part was small, but those who worked with her were impressed by Rebecca's acting skills, and she was considered a sweetheart to work with.
sentences.zh: 戏份虽少，但与她合作过的人都对丽贝卡的演技印象深刻，而且觉得她是个合作起来非常甜美的人。

sentences.en: There was a buzz around Rebecca Schaefer, and her name was on the lips of some of Hollywood's most prominent executives.
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡·谢弗在当时备受瞩目，好莱坞一些最具权势的高管也频频提起她的名字。

sentences.en: The 20-year-old was an up-and-coming actress in
sentences.zh: 这位20岁的姑娘是好莱坞正在崭露头角的

sentences.en: Hollywood, and one to watch.
sentences.zh: 女演员，也是一个值得关注的新星。

sentences.en: Although Robert Bardo had tried to forget Rebecca
sentences.zh: 尽管罗伯特·巴尔多曾试图忘记丽贝卡

sentences.en: Schaefer and replace her with other famous women, none of his new celebrity crushes ever quite lived up to the sweet, innocent Rebecca.
sentences.zh: ·谢弗，并用其他知名女性取而代之，但他迷恋的新名人从来没有一个能完全比得上那个甜美、纯真的丽贝卡。

sentences.en: She was no longer on TV, but there were still occasional TV appearances on talk shows and interviews in magazines.
sentences.zh: 她虽然不再演电视剧，但偶尔还会通过脱口秀节目和杂志采访在电视上露面。

sentences.en: In them, she would talk about the roles that she had in forthcoming films, and Robert noted them carefully in his diary, so he could be sure to see them as soon as they came out.
sentences.zh: 在这些节目中，她会谈论自己即将上映的电影中的角色，罗伯特在日记里仔细记下这些，以便确保它们一上映就能看到。

sentences.en: He was one of the first to buy a ticket to Scenes from the
sentences.zh: 当《比佛利山庄

sentences.en: Class Struggle in Beverly Hills when it was released in May
sentences.zh: 阶级斗争》于1989年
5月上映时，他是第一批买票的人之一。

sentences.en: It was billed as a comedy, and he looked forward to Rebecca reprising her role as a wacky but sweet, wholesome teenager.
sentences.zh: 这部电影被宣传为一部喜剧，他期待着丽贝卡能再次饰演那个古怪但甜美、健康的青春期少女。

sentences.en: What he saw shook him to the core.
sentences.zh: 然而他所看到的却震撼了他的灵魂。

sentences.en: The film was edgier than he expected.
sentences.zh: 这部电影比他预期的要更加前卫。

sentences.en: A dark satire and parody of soap operas.
sentences.zh: 这是一部黑色讽刺剧，也是对肥皂剧的恶搞。

sentences.en: In the film, Rebecca had a love scene in which she appeared in bed with her co-star, Ray Sharkey.
sentences.zh: 在片中，丽贝卡有一场亲热戏，她与联合主演雷·沙基一同出现在床上。

sentences.en: The scene was mild, but sex was clearly implied.
sentences.zh: 这场戏虽然温和，但性暗示非常明显。

sentences.en: Robert's innocent image of Rebecca was shattered.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特心中丽贝卡那纯洁的形象破碎了。

sentences.en: He felt she was just like all the others.
sentences.zh: 他觉得她和所有人一样。

sentences.en: A, quote,
sentences.zh: 用他的话说，

sentences.en: Hollywood whore, prepared to sleep her way to the top.
sentences.zh: 她就是一个准备靠潜规则爬上高位的“好莱坞荡妇”。

sentences.en: Deeply disturbed, Robert went home and wrote to Rebecca again.
sentences.zh: 深感不安的罗伯特回到家，再次给丽贝卡写了信。

sentences.en: His letters took on a more menacing tone.
sentences.zh: 他的信带有了更多威胁的语气。

sentences.en: In one, he called her, quote,
sentences.zh: 在一封信中，他称她为，引述，

sentences.en: Miss Nudity Two-Shoes.
sentences.zh: “纯情玉女赤条条小姐”。

sentences.en: By 1989, Rebecca was working steadily, but had yet to land a role that put her in the spotlight like my sister Sam.
sentences.zh: 到1989年，丽贝卡工作稳定，但尚未获得像《我姐姐萨姆》那样将她推上聚光灯下的角色。

sentences.en: She rekindled her relationship with Brad Silberling in the early part of the year, and the two were soon exclusive.
sentences.zh: 她在今年初与布拉德·西尔伯林旧情复燃，两人很快确定了专一的关系。

sentences.en: The couple celebrated the release of scenes from the class struggle in Beverly Hills, which was popular with both critics and the public,
sentences.zh: 这对情侣庆祝了《比佛利山庄阶级斗争》的上映，该片在影评人和公众中都很受欢迎，

sentences.en: and Brad would sometimes visit Rebecca on the set of the new film she was working on,
sentences.zh: 布拉德有时会去新片片场探班丽贝卡，

sentences.en: The End of Innocence.
sentences.zh: 这部新片是《纯真的终结》。

sentences.en: When they weren't working, they spent their dates with simple home-cooked meals, or cuddled up on the couch with Rebecca's cat, Catherine, named after Catherine Hepburn.
sentences.zh: 不工作的时候，他们会一起吃一顿简单的家常饭菜，或者依偎在沙发上，抱着丽贝卡名叫凯瑟琳的猫（取名自凯瑟琳·赫本）。

sentences.en: The couple started discussing the possibility of getting engaged.
sentences.zh: 两人开始讨论订婚的可能性。

sentences.en: Rebecca had been brought up to have a social conscience.
sentences.zh: 丽贝卡从小就接受了具有社会责任感的教育。

sentences.en: When still at school, she helped her father, child psychologist Dr. Benson Schaefer, teach a class for developmentally disabled youngsters.
sentences.zh: 还在上学时，她就协助父亲——儿童心理学家本森·谢弗博士——给发育迟缓的青少年上课。

sentences.en: In 1989, her chosen cause was Thursday's Child, a charity for at-risk teens and young adults.
sentences.zh: 1989年，她选择投身的事业是“周四的孩子”，这是一个为处于危险边缘的青少年和年轻人服务的慈善机构。

sentences.en: She donated her time and her high profile, becoming a spokesperson for the organisation and helping out when she could.
sentences.zh: 她贡献了自己的时间和高知名度，成为了该组织的代言人，并在力所能及的时候给予帮助。

sentences.en: When she missed a signing event for the charity because of filming commitments, she made a personal appearance at a girl's shelter, where the girls excitedly crowded around her
sentences.zh: 当她因为拍摄工作而错过该慈善机构的一场签名活动时，她亲自现身一个女子庇护所，女孩们兴奋地围在她身旁，

sentences.en: as she graciously signed autographs for all of them.
sentences.zh: 而她则亲切地为所有女孩签名。

sentences.en: Rebecca's popularity had not waned, despite no longer being a regular fixture on people's television sets.
sentences.zh: 尽管不再是人们电视机里的常客，丽贝卡的人气却丝毫未减。

sentences.en: Two sacks of unanswered fan mail sat on her lounge room floor, waiting for Rebecca to have a long enough break in her schedule to get around to them.
sentences.zh: 两麻袋无人回复的粉丝信件堆在她客厅的地上，等待着丽贝卡抽出足够长的假期来处理它们。

sentences.en: Robert Bardo's obsession with Rebecca Schaefer was reignited, but it was different now.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·巴尔多对丽贝卡·谢弗的痴迷再次被点燃，但这次有所不同。

sentences.en: He still loved her, but he believed in new photographs Rebecca had lost some of her youthful sweetness and was looking older and harder.
sentences.zh: 他依然爱她，但他认为从新照片来看，丽贝卡已经失去了一些青春的甜美，看起来更老、更成熟了。

sentences.en: He presumed that it was because she was sleeping around, and he believed she should be punished for her immorality.
sentences.zh: 他揣测这是因为她到处跟人鬼混，并认为她应该为自己的不道德行为受到惩罚。

sentences.en: Frustrated that he had failed on his many attempts to meet or speak to Rebecca,
sentences.zh: 由于多次试图见丽贝卡或与她说话均告失败而感到沮丧，

sentences.en: Rebecca, Robert turned to stories of other celebrity stalkers for hints about how they managed to get close to their targets.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特开始求助于其他名人跟踪狂的故事，以寻找他们如何设法接近目标的线索。

sentences.en: A People magazine article provided inspiration.
sentences.zh: 一篇《人物》杂志的文章提供了灵感。

sentences.en: It told the story of raging bull actress Teresa Saldana, who had nearly been killed in a frenzied stabbing attack by Scottish drifter Arthur Jackson in 1982.
sentences.zh: 文章讲述了曾出演《愤怒的公牛》的女演员特蕾莎·萨尔多纳的故事，她在1982年险些被来自苏格兰的流浪汉亚瑟·杰克逊疯狂刺杀致死。

sentences.en: Jackson had hired a private investigator to get the phone number of the actress's mother, whom he then tricked into giving up Saldana's address.
sentences.zh: 杰克逊曾雇佣一名私家侦探获取这位女演员母亲的电话号码，随后又通过欺骗套出了萨尔多纳的住址。

sentences.en: Robert Bardo pulled out the yellow pages and called the first private investigator listed for Tucson,
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·巴尔多翻开黄页，拨通了图森第一家私家侦探社的电话，

sentences.en: AA Investigators.
sentences.zh: AA侦探社。

sentences.en: They told him they could find anyone, but it would cost at least $250.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉他，他们能找到任何人，但费用至少要250美元。

sentences.en: Robert rifled through his meagre possessions, looking for things he could pawn or sell.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特翻找着自己仅有的微薄财物，寻找可以典当或出售的东西。

sentences.en: The next day, he sold two guitars, about 20 compact discs, and an amplifier, which provided him with enough money to pay the private investigator,
sentences.zh: 第二天，他卖掉了两把吉他、大约20张光盘和一个放大器，这让他筹到了足够的钱来支付给私家侦探，

sentences.en: and have enough left over for a Greyhound bus ticket to Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 并且还剩下足够买一张去洛杉矶的灰狗巴士车票的钱。

sentences.en: On June 1, 1989, Robert Bardo entered the door of AA Investigators, clutching a folder containing several letters and a glossy photograph of smiling Rebecca Schaefer.
sentences.zh: 1989年6月1日，罗伯特·巴尔多走进了AA侦探社的大门，手里紧紧攥着一个文件夹，里面装着几封信和一张面带微笑的丽贝卡·谢弗的光面照片。

sentences.en: He explained to the investigator that Rebecca was an old friend with whom he had corresponded in the past, but they had lost touch when she moved house.
sentences.zh: 他向侦探解释说，丽贝卡是一位老朋友，过去曾通过信件联系，但自从她搬家后就失去了联系。

sentences.en: He wanted her new address so he could send her a gift.
sentences.zh: 他想要她的新地址，这样好给她寄一份礼物。

sentences.en: Robert presented as an ordinary teenager who held down a job and had lived with his parents in the same address in the area for several years.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特表现得像一个普通的青少年，有一份稳定的工作，并且和父母在当地的同一个地址住了好几年。

sentences.en: More importantly, he had $250 in cash ready to pay for a job that would take a few phone calls and cost a couple of bucks.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，他手里有250美元现金，准备支付这项只需要打几个电话、花上几块钱就能完成的工作。

sentences.en: The investigator happily accepted Robert as a client and promised him the information as soon as possible.
sentences.zh: 侦探很高兴地接受了罗伯特这个客户，并承诺会尽快把信息交给他。

sentences.en: What Robert didn't know was that anyone in California could ring the Department of Motor Vehicles
sentences.zh: 罗伯特不知道的是，在加州，任何人都可以打电话给机动车辆管理局，

sentences.en: and for a nominal fee, get someone's driver's license details, including their address.
sentences.zh: 只需支付象征性的费用，就能获取某人的驾照详细信息，包括他们的地址。

sentences.en: He could have done it himself and saved the $250 if he had known.
sentences.zh: 如果他早知道的话，他完全可以自己搞定，还能省下这250美元。

sentences.en: As soon as he left the office, the investigator put in a call to a contact in Los Angeles who easily got Rebecca Schaefer's current address.
sentences.zh: 他刚一离开办公室，侦探就给洛杉矶的一个联系人打了个电话，对方轻而易举地就拿到了丽贝卡·谢弗的现住址。

sentences.en: AA investigators provided their new client with the information and the simple business transaction was settled.
sentences.zh: AA侦探社向他们的新客户提供了这些信息，这桩简单的商业交易就这样完成了。

sentences.en: At the beginning of July, Rebecca Schaefer's agent called with news that could once again change the young woman's life.
sentences.zh: 七月初，丽贝卡·谢弗的经纪人打来电话，带来了一个可能再次改变这位年轻女子命运的消息。

sentences.en: Legendary Hollywood director Frances Ford Coppola wanted her to audition for the third installment of the Godfather trilogy.
sentences.zh: 好莱坞传奇导演弗朗西斯·福特·科波拉想让她为《教父》三部曲的第三部试镜。

sentences.en: The part was Mary Corleone, favourite daughter of the head of a mafia family and a pivotal role in The Godfather Part 3.
sentences.zh: 这个角色是玛丽·科莱昂，黑手党家族首领最疼爱的女儿，也是《教父3》中的关键角色。

sentences.en: Ford Coppola had considered multiple actresses, including Julia Roberts and Madonna, but he believed Rebecca Schaefer was the one who was right for the part.
sentences.zh: 福特·科波拉曾考虑过多位女演员，包括朱莉娅·罗伯茨和麦当娜，但他坚信丽贝卡·谢弗才是最适合这个角色的人。

sentences.en: It was the sort of role that could catapult the 21-year-old out of the B-list and ride into A-list celebrity fame.
sentences.zh: 这样一个角色足以让这位21岁的演员从二线跃升为一线巨星。

sentences.en: Working with one of the most famous directors in the world would open up endless possibilities for a young actress.
